'''Rustan Sharer''' (forum handle '''Rogue4''') served as [[Communications Advocate]] of the [[Players Committee]].<ref name="countdown2014">[https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?p=921494#p921494 Countdown: The 20 most influential volunteers in the PC era], post by AnakinSolo (23 November 2014), Star Wars CCG Players Committee Forums; lists Rustan Sharer &ldquo;rogue4&rdquo; (Communications Advocate) and Mark Peterson &ldquo;lukesbionichand&rdquo; (Rules Advocate)</ref>

The Advocate Council roster of November 2009 lists the handle Rogue4 as Communications Advocate.<ref name="vol2009b">[https://web.archive.org/web/20091126201917/http://www.starwarsccg.org/volunteer/ Volunteer / Advocate Council], starwarsccg.org (Wayback, 26 November 2009)</ref> The announcement of 27 September 2012 naming [[Mike Tomashewski]] [[Design Advocate]] was posted under his handle.<ref name="guard2012">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130221003453/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=346&catid=1&Itemid=117 The Changing Of The Guard], starwarsccg.org (posted 27 September 2012; Wayback, 21 February 2013)</ref> [[Keith Brown]] was announced as a new Advocate on 2 July 2013.<ref name="newadv2013">[https://web.archive.org/web/20130712074825/http://www.starwarsccg.org/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&id=355&catid=1&Itemid=117 A New Advocate!], starwarsccg.org (posted 2 July 2013; Wayback, 12 July 2013)</ref>
